## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Christchurch, New Zealand. It starts at 10 Bridle Path Road.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Ride the Christchurch Gondola in its modern, refurbished cars for views of New Zealand's city. Start at ground level and see the suburbs, the Port Hills, Lyttelton Harbour, and the Southern Alps. At the top, visit the Red Rock Cafe for a drink and views. You can also ride the Time Tunnel to learn about the area's history. A trip on the Christchurch Gondola offers several local sights and activities worth checking out.
